name: sprouty related EVH1 domain containing 1
pathways: negative regulation of intracellular signal transduction
positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: SPRED1 encodes sprouty-related, EVH1 domain-containing protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity and phosphatase binding. It participates in negative regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Legius syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
